ssc-chsl-typing: SSC CHSL typing test will be conducted by staff selection board (SSC) SSC CHSL typing requires a minimum speed of 35 w.p.m. for English or 30 w.p.m. for Hindi for a duration of 10 minutes. The test is mandatory for qualifying and is conducted on a computer. While no marks are awarded, candidates must meet the speed requirements and maintain high accuracy. SSC CHSL typing test 2025 is required so as to qualify for the final selection.

Candidates who want to do English Typing will be required to type at a speed of 35 words per minute (10,500 key depressions/hour) and candidates who want to do Hindi typing will be typed at 30 words per minute (9,000 key depressions/hour) with in 10 minutes (15 minutes for PwD candidates).  During application, you are supposed to choose either English or Hindi as your typing language. Nothing to be changed afterwards. The text passage-to be typed will be on the screen in the test. You have to type without stopping in 10 minutes (15 minutes in case of PwD).
ssc-cgl-typing: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) conducts the ssc cgl typing Test 2025, also known as the Data Entry Speed Test (DEST), as a part of the SSC CGL Tier 2 Examination for Group B and C positions. This computer-based test assesses a candidate's typing speed and accuracy in either English or Hindi .Prepare for SSC CGL tier 2 typing test online with typingmitra in realtime exam experience. It contains many passages to practice online for SSC CGL typing 2025. The Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level (SSC CGL 2025 Typing test) exam includes typing test in Tier-II. It is a qualifying in nature
csir-exam-new-rules(formula): CSIR JSA (Junior Secretariat Assistant) typing test, candidates must type at a speed of 35 words per minute (wpm) in English or 30 wpm in Hindi. The test is a 10-minute duration. The medium of the test is either Hindi or English, and candidates will choose their preferred language at the venue. Only "Kruti Dev" font will be used for Hindi typing tests.
mp-cpct-typing: To be declared CPCT Qualified, a candidate must secure at least 38 marks in MCQ, and/or 30 NWPM in English typing, and/or 20 NWPM in Hindi typing. The CPCT exam includes two 15-minute typing tests (English and Hindi) The certificate will validate qualification for each of these three sections independently based on a 50% minimum score.
upsssc-junior-assistant-typing: UPSSSC Junior Assistant Typing Test 2026 will be conducted by UPSSSC. UPSSSC Junior Assistant (JA) typing exam is a recruitment drive conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission for government clerical roles. Candidates who clear the written exam must pass a mandatory qualifying typing test on a computer Hindi: Minimum 25 words per minute (WPM)English: Minimum 30 words per minute (WPM)

UPSSSC Junior Assistant typing test 2026 (UPSSSC JA Typing) requires a minimum speed of 25 WPM in Hindi (Mangal Inscript or Kruti Dev 010) and 30 WPM. Time duration for both test is 5-5 minutes includes a strict 5-error penalty system.  The test is entirely qualifying. You must pass both Hindi and English typing; failing one means total disqualification from the selection cycle
